name: SmartyMe
what_it_is: Daily microlearning app with 15-minute read/listen lessons on communication, public speaking, productivity and psychology.
notes: Seed — verified: it's lesson-content microlearning, not drill-based; users report applying tips but few interactive exercises.

name: Poised
what_it_is: Desktop AI communication coach giving real-time feedback during actual video meetings (energy, clarity, filler words).
notes: Feedback-in-context model; lessons exist but exercises are secondary.

name: BoldVoice
what_it_is: Accent and pronunciation coaching app from Hollywood accent coaches with daily drills and AI feedback, aimed at non-native English speakers.
notes: Adjacent (accent) but drill design and video-lesson+practice loop is instructive.

name: Astound — Voice & Speech Coach
what_it_is: Voice/speech coaching app focused on how your voice feels and lands (calm, presence, resonance) with short daily practices.
notes: App Store listing describes daily practice structure.

name: TalkTune
what_it_is: AI communication coaching with real-time voice analysis and realistic conversation simulations for professionals.

name: YourMove AI
what_it_is: AI dating assistant for openers, replies, profile writing; ~250k users.
notes: Crutch-style (does it for you) rather than training, but shows demand and scenario taxonomy.

name: Cues
what_it_is: Social-intelligence training app for decoding social cues and body language.
notes: Perception-side training (reading people) complements expression-side wit.
